notes.title: 1.2.0 - The Survival Update
notes.notes:
Hello there, Vladirien here!

A new content update has just dropped, introducing an exciting new survival gamemode!

In this mode, you'll battle through numerous waves of increasingly challenging enemies.

[h2]New content[/h2]

[list]
[*] New Survival gamemode: Survive relentless enemy waves and emerge victorious!
[*] New achievement: Earn a new achievement by conquering the survival gamemode.
[*] New relics 
[list]
[*] Stillness Tactics : Skills recharge twice as fast when stationary.
[*] Sidearm : Fire bullets towards close enemies when reloading
[*] Radioactive Decay : Chance to create a damaging radioactive area.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Improvements & balance[/h2]

[list]
[*] Baara's Bullet Storm skill : Now holds an additional charge for enhanced mobility.
[*] Enhanced UI: Improved weapon and perk selection interface.
[*] Enemy Health: Increased health for enemies in the late game.
[*] Fire Elites: Death explosion now covers a smaller area
[*] Scavenger Relic: Ammo Packs now also reduce current skill cooldowns.
[*] Last Stand Relic: now also grants a speed boost at 1 HP
[*] And finally... Loading screen tips !
[/list]

See you on the Frontline!

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hello there!

Small update of Frontline Survivors to fix some bugs and add some improvements.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Add proper sliders for Music and SFX volume
[*]Camp road blocks no longer behave like sandbags, meaning they can be shoot at no matter the distance

[/list]

[list]
[*]Fix condition for achievement "We Got the Moves" being the same as "All Guns Blazing"

notes.title: 1.1.0 - The Weapons Update
notes.notes:
Hello there, Vladirien here!

A new content update just dropped... And it brings weapons, [b]MORE WEAPONS[/b]!

[h2]New content[/h2]
Each character gets an extra weapon :
[list][*]     Bob gets the [b]Carbine[/b]: a powerful semi automatic rifle that gets unprecise if fired too often
[*]     Gwen gets the [b]Charge Shotgun[/b]: a shotgun that can be charged to reduce spread and pick off targets at longer range
[*]     Kazy gets the [b]Pipe Cannon[/b]: a special single ammo shotgun with explosive strength
[*]     Rando gets the [b]Beam Rifle[/b]: a prototype weapon which can charge a devastating laser beam
[*]     Baara get the [b]Plasma Repeater[/b]: an experimental weapon which can be charged to lock unstable projectiles onto targets
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43646009/38b2eb3c4e54ce4fb645004cc2d0f8d2d4f5b53c.gif[/img]
[h3]New perks:[/h3]   
[list][*]      [b]Polyvalent[/b]: Increase weapon reload BUT your weapon changes on every level up
[*]     [b]Toxic[/b]: Bleed applications have a 50% chance to also apply Neurotoxin
[/list]
[h3]New relics:[/h3]
[list][*]     [b]Toxic Shock[/b]: Emit electricity when Neurotoxin expires
[*]     [b]Recycler[/b]: Passively reloads magazine
[/list]
New camp type : the Barracks which spawn soldiers until killed

New variations for the camp tiles so it appears more "man-made"

... And finally 3 new achievements!

[h2]Improvements and balance[/h2]
[list][*] Add screen resolution configuration settings
[*] Flak Cannon deals more damage and its projectile speed is increased
[*] Sniper, Hunting Shotgun & Combat shotgun deal more damage
[*] The Energized perk now increases electric damage on every bounce instead of a flat boost
[*] It will now rain twice more often when picking the Waterproof perk
[*] Fire created by enemies now appear with a red tint so they are harder to confuse with allied fires
[*]Baara's All Guns Blazing's skill now also increase her reload speed for the duration
[/list]

See you on the Frontline!

notes.title: Frontline Survivors Update - Introducing Perks!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Vladirien here!

I'm thrilled to unveil the most recent Frontline Survivors update, and it brings something exciting to the table: Perks!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43646009/448d871d7284b9af4da9987184149be2f6ac0397.png[/img]

With this new addition, you'll have the freedom to pick two Perks from a wide array of options. Each Perk bestows a distinct advantage for your upcoming runs. The best part? You can mix and match these Perks to tailor your gameplay to your own unique style!

Want to specialize in electric mayhem? Grab the "Energized" Perk. Or perhaps you're in the mood to assemble a formidable army with the "Stylish" Perk.

Dive into the action on the Frontline and let the fun begin!
